stem:
A student rode a bike from school to a recreation center. The graph shows the student’s distance in miles from the recreation center after riding the bike for x minutes.

What is the range of the function for this situation?

options.label: F
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 28

options.label: G
options.text: All real numbers greater than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 9

options.label: H
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to 28

options.label: J
options.text: All real numbers less than or equal to 9

visual_elements: Graph titled 'Bike Ride' with y-axis labeled 'Distance from Recreation Center (mi)' and x-axis labeled 'Time (min)'. Graph shows a line starting at (0,9) and ending at (28,0).
